title: Live Cart Progress and Faster Transitions

sections.name: Checkout
items: Confirmed carts now immediately update the Carted count. Click the cart icon to see those tasks while checkout, CAPTCHA handling, or order submission continues.
Carted tasks leave the cart filter when completed, declined, or stopped. A fresh task start resets its previous cart progress.
Ready pages advance with faster checks and no fixed cart-opening delay, while keeping the same wait limits for slow storefront responses.
Opening the cart no longer risks clicking Add to Cart again. Disabled Place Order controls are not reported as submitted.

instructions: Open Brava, go to Settings, check for updates, then select Update & restart.
